dataset: Woolsey Fire 2018 evacuation zones and zone-targeted orders (curated)
interpretation: LA and Ventura Counties had no pre-defined evacuation zones in 2018. Zones here are (a) polygons from the Ventura County OES public incident web map, archived by the Wayback Machine (observed geometry, in effect at capture time); (b) TIGER/Line 2018 place polygons for cities an order named whole (reconstructed); (c) areas named in orders whose boundary is not unambiguous from public geometry (geometry null, geometry_status unknown with a reason). Times are Pacific Standard Time (UTC-8) unless marked as Wayback capture times (UTC). Page 'as of' times and capture times are latest bounds: the order was issued at or before them. Quotes are as written, 25 words or fewer.

vcemergency-wayback.provider: County of Ventura, VC Emergency (www.vcemergency.com) home page, Woolsey/Hill Fire incident information, archived by the Internet Archive Wayback Machine
vcemergency-wayback.license: public government web page; no license stated; order lists transcribed, page not redistributed

zones.name: City of Malibu
zones.order_source_locator: Citygate AAR SE70 (p. 63): Malibu Alert notice 6:57 AM, '(6:50 AM) all of City of Malibu'
zones.notes: Conflict: Citygate SE65 (5:30 AM) 'announces mandatory evacuation for Malibu' (planning Zone 3, not mapped here); news reports (e.g. Variety, Deadline) say the whole city was ordered at 10 a.m. Nov 9. The Malibu Alert time is used.

zones.name: City of Westlake Village
zones.order_source_locator: Citygate AAR SE53 (p. 61), 2:34 AM: 'Mandatory evacuation ordered for Westlake Village.'
zones.notes: Read as the incorporated city (LA County Fire area); the source does not say 'City of'.

zones.name: City of Hidden Hills
zones.order_source_locator: Citygate AAR SE31 (p. 59), 7:09 PM PIO tweet; SE59 (p. 62) names the 'City of Hidden Hills' as moved from mandatory to voluntary
zones.notes: The 7:09 PM order covers 'north of the Highway 101 from Valley Circle to Lindero Cyn'; every TIGER vertex of the city lies north of OSM US 101 and west of Valley Circle Blvd (derived check), so the city is wholly inside that area. Downgraded to voluntary about 3:00 AM (SE56) / reported 3:57 AM (SE59).
